$comment: Per-building corrections to what the June 2010 LiDAR survey (behind the DataSF footprint heights) saw. Each entry sets exactly one of heightM (a roof height: a public record for a building completed after the survey, or, with placeholder: true, a stand-in plinth until a landmark model replaces the record; a placeholder keeps no storeys, use or units) and keepTower: true (the LiDAR tower stands although the spike check would drop it: a real steeple over a nave the roll counts as one storey; the build fails if no tower results). Pipeline config only: names here are provenance, never shipped into tiles. Keyed by sf16_bldgid; parcel is checked so a footprint id change fails the build loudly instead of silently mis-applying. World QA W-04: an entry with add: true adds a building the 2016 footprint layer does not have, from its parcel's polygon (pipeline/lib/newer.ts; id 201006.99xxxxx, never a DataSF id): heightM is its roof, podiumM with towerFraction a podium and its tower, at and sizeM a rectangle cut out of a large lot; the records it stands on are retired.

buildings.label: 415 Mission St tower
buildings.source: Completed 2018. Roof height 326 m (1,070 ft), public record (CTBUH Skyscraper Center). The footprint dataset reports a 0.24 m median height here: in June 2010 the site was the old Transbay Terminal ramps.

buildings.label: Sutro Tower upper structure (lattice, seen from above)
buildings.source: Placeholder until a landmark model replaces the sutro-tower probe's records. Sutro Tower is a 298 m open steel lattice on three legs (public record); the footprint dataset outlines its upper structure as seen from above, and the LiDAR fills that outline as a solid prism (median 210.4 m, max 286.4 m over 683 m²). A 3 m plinth marks the footprint instead of a 231 m solid block.

buildings.label: Mission Dolores Basilica bell tower
buildings.source: The basilica beside the old mission chapel (parcel 3566001, built 1913 per the 2025 roll) has bell towers over its front; the LiDAR max over the footprint is 39.0 m above a 14.1 m median, a tower the moment model accepts (about 55 m², rising 3.4 times its width). The roll lists 1 storey (the nave is one tall room), so the spike check reads the tower as a LiDAR spike. Kept: the LiDAR is the evidence, the storey count is not.

buildings.label: Transbay Transit Center (deck over 1st St)
buildings.source: W-01, W-16. Completed 2018: the Transit Center's rooftop park stands about 21 m (70 ft) over the street (public record), and the building is carried over 1st and Fremont Streets on bridges. In June 2010 the site was the old terminal's demolition pit: the footprint dataset reports a 2.58 m median and a 68 m maximum (a crane), which drew a 68 m tower on 1st St. The height override removes that tower; the carriageway clearance pass (pipeline/lib/clearance.ts) turns the part over 1st St into a span with an underside.

buildings.label: Park Tower at Transbay (250 Howard St)
buildings.source: W-04. Completed 2019, 43 storeys; 184.5 m (605 ft) to the top of the tower, public record. The footprint is the old lot's (3718037; the 2025 roll's parcel is 3718040), and the roll's 43 storeys at the office storey height drew it at 173.7 m.

buildings.label: The Avery (488 Folsom St), Transbay Block 9
buildings.source: W-04. Completed 2019, 56 storeys, 188 m (618 ft) to the roof, public record; the block's lower buildings are drawn as a 25 m podium over the lot (Transbay Block 9, parcel 3737042 and its condominium lots). The footprint layer predates it: in 2010 the block was the old terminal's ramps. Tower centred on the lot (placement approximate).

buildings.label: 33 Tehama St
buildings.source: W-04. Completed 2018; the 2025 roll lists 35 storeys and 403 units on parcel 3736190 (41 Tehama St). About 120 m to the roof (published figures are close to 400 ft). The footprint layer predates it. Tower over most of the lot (placement approximate).

buildings.label: Fifteen Fifty (1550 Mission St), 1500 Mission block
buildings.source: W-04. Completed 2020, 39 storeys, about 116 m to the roof (the world QA report's published 116 to 122 m). The 1500 Mission block (parcel 3506012) was rebuilt; the roll lists no storeys for it, and the footprint layer shows the buildings it replaced, which this entry retires across the lot. Tower centred on the block over a 25 m podium (placement approximate).

buildings.label: Chase Center arena (Mission Bay)
buildings.source: W-04. Completed 2019; an arena about 40 m tall on the Mission Bay block (parcel 8722022's lot, 8722021). The footprint layer predates it (a parking lot in 2010). A 120 x 150 m block at the QA report's point stands in for the arena's rounded bowl; the lot's two office buildings are not added (no storeys in the roll).
